slider.label: Zoom
slider.name: ks_zoom
slider.tool_tip: Camera view angle: Ctrl+0 zooms in, Ctrl+8 out, Ctrl+9 resets. With depth of field on, it changes the blur.

check_box.label: Depth of field
check_box.name: ks_dof
check_box.tool_tip: Blurs the view except at the camera focus. Off while an edit tool, the Poser included, is open, unless depth of field in edit mode is on (the Poser's Enable DoF in Edit Mode, or Preferences > Graphics > Enable while in edit mode).

check_box.label: Focus follows pointer
check_box.name: ks_focus_follows
check_box.tool_tip: Focus on whatever is under the mouse pointer, as in flycam. Use with Focus locked.

check_box.label: Focus locked (Alt-Shift-X)
check_box.name: ks_focus_locked
check_box.tool_tip: Keeps the current focus while you move the pointer; Alt-Shift-X toggles it. Use with Focus follows pointer.

check_box.label: Show focus point
check_box.name: ks_focus_show
check_box.tool_tip: Draws a crosshair at the focus point: yellow when free, red when locked.

combo_box.name: ks_dof_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Depth-of-field renderer: Standard (Firestorm), aperture-sampled (for still images), or Live (layered, noise-free). Every session starts with Standard. The same list as the AyaneStorm Depth of Field floater.

slider.label: F-number
slider.name: ks_fnumber
slider.tool_tip: Lens f-number: lower makes the sharp zone shallower (more blur in front of and behind the focus).

slider.label: Focal length (mm)
slider.name: ks_focal
slider.tool_tip: Simulated lens length in millimeters, at the Field of view below: higher makes the sharp zone shallower.

slider.label: Field of view (deg)
slider.name: ks_fov
slider.tool_tip: The view angle, in degrees, at which Focal length applies. Zooming in from it lengthens the simulated lens (more blur); zooming out shortens it. Does not change the view.

slider.label: Max blur (CoC)
slider.name: ks_max_coc
slider.tool_tip: Largest blur, in pixels, for things far from the focus. Does not change what is sharp.

slider.label: DoF resolution
slider.name: ks_dof_res
slider.tool_tip: Resolution of the blur pass: 1 is full, 0.25 a quarter. Lower is faster and softer.

button.label: Depth of Field...
button.name: ks_open_as_dof
button.tool_tip: Opens the AyaneStorm Depth of Field floater.
